messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary error spike detected on /v2/prompt-route (experimental endpoint). Canary group: canary-3. Error rate >= 10% for 3m. See: https://ops.metrics/redwood/canary-3

alice: paging @ben_oncall — can you take? this is the new prompt routing rollout.

ben_oncall: taking pager. joining now. any quick customer impact notes?

alice: telemetry shows 11% 5xx and 20% user-facing timeouts. roughly 5% of overall traffic routed to this canary. noticed spike started right after the 12:07 deploy.

ops-monitor: alert details: 
- alert: canary_request_error_rate
- threshold: > 8% (3m)
- metric: service.request_errors{route:"/v2/prompt-route",env:"prod"}
- current_value: 11.3%
- p50 latency (canary): 1.2s -> p50 (stable): 220ms
- trace sample: https://traces/redwood/trace/0ab12

ben_oncall: oncall note — this is the experimental routing flag. I'm going to try a soft kill on the FF first (toggle routing to stable). Anyone object?

maria-sre: agreed, if kill-switch is quick and reversible. also start a canary abort rollback if flag flip doesn't help in 2m.

sam-eng: FYI we rolled out a change to contextual prompt rewriting in the router at 12:07. Could be NPE when certain metadata is missing. I can look but please flip the flag to stop customer impact.

ben_oncall: executing kill-switch now:
```
# feature-flag cli (internal)
ff-toggle --org=redwood --flag=prompt_route_experimental --set=off --scope=canary-3 --reason="emergency kill due to 5xx spike" --actor=ben_oncall
```

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Feature flag update requested by ben_oncall. Request id: fk-9302. Applying change to canary-3...

deploy-bot: [SUCCESS] flag prompt_route_experimental set to OFF for canary-3 at 1829001310.

ops-monitor: post-toggle metrics (30s window): error rate -> 4.1%, latency p50 -> 380ms. Not fully recovered but trending down.

alice: good. looks like most errors were coming from the experimental branch. still seeing a tail of timeouts. recommend full rollback of the deploy or expand kill to all traffic if it doesn't stabilize in 3m.

ben_oncall: escalate to @maria-sre for handoff, I've got a second page about infra noise. Maria, can you take incident lead?

maria-sre: taking lead. assigning incident channel: #incident-1829001234 (temp). ben, please drop any ongoing findings in this thread.

sam-eng: quick snippet from router logs around 12:07:
```
ERR router: failed applyRewrite: missing field "user_locale" -> panic at rewrite.go:87
stack: ...
```
That aligns with the NPE theory. There was a change that assumes metadata exists for a subset of customers.

zach-cs: heads up from support: two customers reported degraded responses (ticket 9874, 9876). Both on enterprise plans. They've been notified we are investigating.

maria-sre: customer impact assessment: 
- impacted surface: prompt routing to experimental endpoint only (canary-3), ~5% of production traffic, includes 3 enterprise customers by shard mapping.
- severity: P1 (partial outage for small subset)
- data loss/exfiltration: none observed.

maria-sre: mitigation plan (short): 
1) widen FF kill to all traffic for prompt_route_experimental if metrics don't fall under 1% errors in next 3m.
2) rollback the 12:07 revision from canary->stable if FF change insufficient.
3) patch router to guard missing metadata.
4) after stable, notify affected customers with timeline.

ben_oncall: 2m after initial kill: metrics stable-ish: error rate 0.6%, p50 260ms. will keep monitoring.

ops-monitor: note: synthetic job for critical customers still reporting occasional 502s (3 out of 120 checks). Could be warmup/backpressure; trending down.

sam-eng: I'm going to prepare a fix branch. estimate 30-45m to test and ship. If we can keep stable, i'll push a hotfix and then do a controlled rollout.

alice: can we get a quick postmortem owner? suggest sam-eng for remediation and maria-sre for incident write-up.

maria-sre: assigned. incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/incident-1829001234 (creating now).

ben_oncall: handing back oncall to the rota. I will follow up with any infra alerts.

maria-sre: summary for exec update: 
- root cause: unguarded assumption in prompt rewrite code that certain request metadata exists; caused panics -> 5xx for experimental routing path.
- mitigation: feature flag killed for canary (12:15) then auto-stabilized; full-traffic kill not required.
- customer impact: ~5% traffic; 3 enterprise customers saw degraded responses for ~8-12 minutes; tickets opened and CS notified.

zach-cs: confirming outreach sent to affected customers with temporary mitigation steps and ETA for patch.

maria-sre: closing actions: 
- sam-eng to PR hotfix + test (owner: sam-eng)
- sam-eng to create canary plan for safe rollout and add metadata guards (due EOD)
- ops to add guardrail alert when rewrite panics occur (owner: alice)
- incident write-up by maria-sre (draft in 24h)

sam-eng: noted. I'll add a unit test and patch in next 2 hours.

alice: good job everyone. leaving the incident channel open for follow-ups. please update incident doc with timeline+links. :thumbsup:
